subject.title: [Feature/Bug]: Isolate subagent completion from parent context; return status + child session link only by default

question: Should native subagent completion become metadata-only by default, retain the current result-bearing contract with a hard cap, or offer both through an explicit compatibility policy?
rationale: Current main deliberately promises a final result to the parent, while the requested default changes orchestration behavior, may add configuration, and affects channels, nested agents, and existing workflows; source inspection cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Bounded result envelope
options.body: Keep status, identifiers, and a strictly capped child summary/final result by default, with explicit bounded retrieval for additional detail.

options.title: Metadata-only default
options.body: Deliver only status and a child-session handle by default, accepting an extra retrieval/model step and providing a documented migration path for existing workflows.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Retain automatic final-result delivery and address only accounting, sizing, stale-delivery, and channel-leak defects.

recommendation.title: Bounded result envelope
recommendation.body: Keep status, identifiers, and a strictly capped child summary/final result by default, with explicit bounded retrieval for additional detail.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail connects this person to the original completion contract and its recent orchestration and context-delivery revisions.
